summary: Let P be the rank-three projector onto the first three normalized Walsh columns in dimension 8 and A_t=tI+(1-t)P, 0<t<=1/2. Then spectrum(A_t)={1,1,1,t,t,t,t,t}, but exact exhaustive symbolic enumeration over every physical pivot and every residual original-coordinate cut gives max |d|^6 e_3(BB^T)=t^2(1-t)^6(5t+3)^4/2^20 ->0. Hence the bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis cannot force a universal positive pivot-E3 certificate. This does not refute QFORM: the newest Fresnel-Brascamp-Lieb theorem applies to the same family and gives ||p||_infinity<=12/(1-t)<=24. The report also proves an original-matrix overlap-one minor-bank transducer from the account03/B03 E_k partner theorem.
